name: mnemonic_shard_resonance
label: Mnemonic Shard Resonance
poeticVision: The player will feel the precarious, fragile life of memory itself through sound. They will experience the visceral horror of identity being torn apart as the unique, harmonious resonance of a sought-after memory fragment distorts into a jarring cacophony, signaling the crushing presence of the Silence. It's the sound of the past actively dying, forcing a frantic, desperate race against sonic annihilation to save what remains of oneself.
usage: Attach this script to a Node3D representing a memory shard. Configure the 'base_frequency' and 'base_amplitude' to define the shard's unique resonance. Set 'max_corruption_distance' and 'min_corruption_distance' to control how proximity to a Silence Hunter affects the sound. Provide the 'silence_hunter_path' to the actual Node3D instance of the hunter in your scene. The script will automatically create and manage an AudioStreamPlayer3D and a custom AudioStreamGenerator to produce the dynamic, corrupting sound. Call the 'lose_memory()' function when the memory shard is permanently lost to switch its sound to unrecoverable 'dead static'.

parameters.name: base_frequency
parameters.description: Base frequency of the memory shard's unique resonance (Hz).

parameters.name: base_amplitude
parameters.description: Base amplitude (volume) of the memory shard's resonance (0.0 to 1.0).

parameters.name: max_corruption_distance
parameters.description: Distance from the Silence Hunter at which corruption begins (0.0 corruption).

parameters.name: min_corruption_distance
parameters.description: Distance from the Silence Hunter at which corruption is maximum (1.0 corruption).

parameters.name: silence_hunter_path
parameters.description: NodePath to the Silence Hunter (a Node3D) for proximity detection and corruption calculation.

verdict: A symphony of self-destruction, where the fading harmony of memory becomes the chilling soundtrack to a desperate fight for identity.
impact: This mechanic transforms the abstract concept of memory loss into a tangible, auditory horror. Players will constantly feel the encroaching Silence not just visually, but through a deeply personal sonic assault on their very identity, forcing a desperate, adrenaline-fueled race against the dying echoes of their past. It provides immediate, visceral feedback on both external threat and internal decay, making every moment a tense struggle for self-preservation.
